state_rules.active: Can be used for operational pilots when linked to a gate/checklist.
state_rules.draft: Can be used as a template or design artifact only; it cannot certify a Signal.
state_rules.disabled: Must not be used by runtime or dashboard selection.

promotion_guardrails: A profile never turns a pre-screen score into an Opportunity Signal.
A profile must define customer-path observables before a gate can promote findings.
A profile must define unsafe language before client-facing artifacts are generated.
A profile must identify required sources and allowed sources separately.
A profile with status draft can support planning, not live evidence claims.
